_README: Maps a scoreboard operation's target to the group slugs used by the victim
series, so a claimed outcome can be checked against observed leak-site posting.
DATA, not code. Add or correct mappings here.
A target can map to SEVERAL slugs. LockBit posts as lockbit3 and lockbit5;
counting only one would show a collapse that never happened.
successor_slugs are brands the research says the same operators moved to.
They are counted SEPARATELY, never added to the original: a brand dying while
its operators carry on somewhere else is a real outcome, and the whole point
of the scoreboard's 'Brand dead' verdict. Merging them would erase the
Leave slugs empty where the group never appears in the series. The check will
report it as unverifiable rather than pretending zero victims means success.

Hive.note: Operation Jan 2023, before the victim series begins in Jan 2024. Not checkable here.

ALPHV/BlackCat.note: Exit scam Dec 2023; affiliates widely assessed to have moved to RansomHub.

LockBit.note: Cronos Feb 2024. Posts under multiple versioned brands.

8 REvil members.note: Russian domestic prosecution; REvil absent from the series by then.

Phobos / 8Base.note: Phobos itself is an affiliate-run family and does not post as a named leak-site brand.

BlackSuit (ex-Royal).note: Royal to BlackSuit to Chaos lineage; the site's own group pages treat chaos as the current iteration.

Karen Vardanyan (Ryuk deployer).note: An individual prosecution, not a brand. No leak-site signal to check.
